heading: Are you starting as an Adult, Teen or Child?

cards.title: Child
cards.description: You are a Child, overlooked and underestimated by the world. But your journey has just begun. With wide eyes and untapped spirit, you’ll rise through hardship, discovering strength, allies, and purpose one step at a time. Every legend starts small.

cards.title: Teen
cards.description: You are a Teen, full of fire, dreams, and raw potential. You're just beginning to carve your mark on the world. Whether you're chasing adventure or justice, your future is unwritten, and your will is strong enough to split the seas.

cards.title: Adult
cards.description: You are an Adult, seasoned by life and hardened by the sea. Your path has already taken shape, shaped by choices, battles, and scars. Whether pirate, marine, or wanderer your experience is your greatest weapon, and the world already knows your name... or soon will.
